findings.summary: The mechanism, which is the section's whole point, was removed.

evidence.baseline: It need not involve any explicit transaction or quid pro quo. It operates through the internalization, often below the level of conscious awareness, of what will and will not generate continued financial support. Institutions that depend on funders with specific interests will, over time, come to understand their mission in terms that are compatible with those interests, without any single decision having compromised the institutional mission.

findings.diagnosis: Without any single decision having compromised the mission is the sentence that makes financial capture undetectable by audit of individual decisions, and it is the reason the remedies are structural rather than procedural. It is also the mechanism the donor scenario dramatizes and the Lessig lineage supports.

findings.summary: The four design responses lost their specificity.

evidence.baseline: diversification of funding sources, so that no single funder or category of funders provides more than a specified percentage of the institution's operating budget; explicit governance firewalls between funders and programmatic decisions; legal structures that limit funders' ability to condition their contributions; and regular constitutional audits that evaluate whether programmatic decisions have drifted.

findings.diagnosis: A specified percentage of the operating budget is the only quantified safeguard in Part III. Constitutional audits appear here for the first time and are referred to as an established mechanism in five later chapters. The Chapter Twenty-Four donor process refers to the funding firewall of Chapter Eleven by name, which the shipped text does not contain.

openQuestions: The volume-04 voice card was prepared by the same pass that produced the shipped text, and its exemplar anchors and protected lines quote that text rather than the baseline. The card records `Author approved: pending tone, strategy, heading, and overcompression review`. The restoration keeps every line the card protects and otherwise follows the baseline, which means card and source now diverge in wording the card does not name. R-VOICE-BIND requires that the disagreement be raised rather than settled here: the card should be re-derived from whichever text the author approves.

Structural labels were frozen for this pass and none was touched. Every markdown heading, every standalone bold display line, every chapter label, and every all-capital display line is byte identical to its pre-edit state, in the same order, with the same blank-line separators on both sides. A label determines a section id, a section id is a public route, and `publishing/continuity/section-lineage.json` already records this volume's renames and resolves the historical routes. Changing one is a continuity decision and not an editorial one. Only the running prose between labels was restored. Where a baseline label names its section better than the current one, the cost is recorded here and the label is left alone.
